data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word Shri, meaning goddess of wealth, and Mila, meaning friend. The name Sharmila represents the goddess of love, beauty, and strength. It is a beautiful and powerful name that inspires a sense of grace and resilience. The name Sharmila carries the meaning “Goddess of love, beauty, and strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharmila usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love, beauty, and strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharmila is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism, as it is derived from the names of various goddesses, such as Saraswati, Lakshmi, and Parvati. It is believed to bring blessings of love, prosperity, and strength to the bearer of this name.
data.etymology: Sharmila belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of love, beauty, and strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharmila total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
